_comment: Pinned versions the Playground consumes in 'package' runtime mode (see scripts/lib/sources.mjs). Bump these to move to a newer published Fade/MonoGame web runtime. Env vars FADE_EXPORT_WEB_VERSION / FADE_LIB_WEB_VERSION / FADE_EXPORT_MONOGAME_VERSION / FADE_MONOGAME_VERSION override individual entries.
